paper_title: The Organization of Environmental Coupling Shapes What Quantum Reservoirs Remember

release.continuous_drive_narma_washout_validatio: tar -xzf results/continuous_drive_narma_washout_v1_results.tar.gz -C results && PYTHONPATH=src:experiments python experiments/run_continuous_drive_narma_washout.py verify --out results/continuous_drive_narma_washout_v1
release.reader_index: included in the public repository release; it maps, but does not alter, the frozen numerical evidence snapshot

recorded_environments.scope_note: other sealed protocols carry their own source_environment or software block; no single environment is asserted for every historical run

software_and_numerics.propagator: scipy.sparse.linalg.expm_multiply with library defaults; no user-set tolerance
software_and_numerics.positive_ridge_solver: solve(X.T @ X + ridge * I, X.T @ y)

collective_process.frobenius_target: B=N*2^(N-1) for the unit-rate local reference; B=80 at N=5 and rematched separately within each finite size
collective_process.exception: the separate profile-by-family interaction check fits a nonuniform collective profile

shared.couplings: J_ij independently uniform on [-1,1] for i<j
shared.pairing: same Hamiltonian, input, target, and split within each seed

process_parameters_before_common_frobeni.uniform_local_relaxation: unit downward rate at every site
process_parameters_before_common_frobeni.unequal_local_relaxation: rates log-uniform on [0.1,10], then rescaled to arithmetic mean 1
process_parameters_before_common_frobeni.exchange_assisted_relaxation: 40 percent of B local lowering and 60 percent ordered excitation-conserving exchange
process_parameters_before_common_frobeni.dephasing: one local sigma_i^z jump per site

mackey_glass.initial_history: x0=1.2 plus 0.01*Normal(0,1) over the delay history from the task RNG
mackey_glass.normalization: affine minimum and maximum from the washout-plus-training prefix only
mackey_glass.feedback_clipping: closed-loop predictions fed back to the reservoir are clipped to [0,1]; held-out normalized targets remain unclipped

fresh_parity.generator: revision-control deterministic pool generated from the namespace

finite_size.nesting: principal submatrices of one N=8 draw

switched_input_convergence.input_pairing: the same switched input sequence is used for every initial state within a lineage
distance_records: maximum trace distance over all six initial-state pairs
maximum Pauli-feature distance over all six initial-state pairs

flagship_collective_n5_continuation.verification: the complete reviewer bundle validator checks all eight checkpoints and the frozen protocol

local_pair_cross_size_continuation.verification: the complete reviewer bundle validator checks all 48 checkpoints, their frozen 800-step prefixes, and the six tail gates

continuous_drive_narma10_strict_washout.purpose: test the principal continuous-drive NARMA-10 ordering after a strict washout without changing the scored training or test rows
continuous_drive_narma10_strict_washout.lineages: all 32 principal N=5 pairs in their canonical sorted seed order
continuous_drive_narma10_strict_washout.strict_input_rule: prepend an independent frozen 600-input prefix to the unchanged canonical 1200-input sequence, leaving the final 200 washout inputs and the 600 training plus 400 test rows identical to W200
continuous_drive_narma10_strict_washout.serialization_amendment: version 1 stopped after the eight prespecified audit checkpoints because unavailable non-audit diagnostics were serialized as NaN; version 2 changed only those unavailable values to JSON null and reran the complete protocol
continuous_drive_narma10_strict_washout.scope: certifies only the continuous-drive local-versus-collective NARMA-10 endpoint under the tested W800 protocol; it does not certify the full cross-family task map

switched_input_convergence.scope: the initialization-independent headline claim is the principal N=5 local-versus-collective comparison; the fixed-initialization N=4,...,8 sweep has a separate descriptive role

activity_matched_control.all_cells_gate: all 16 calibrations must pass before task scoring

reset_architecture_replication.purpose: test whether the principal collective-over-local ordering transfers from continuous-drive encoding to input-by-reset

autonomous_processor.hamiltonian: complete-graph XX couplings independently drawn from U[-1,1] plus h sum_i Z_i

readout.features: 45 one-body and same-axis two-body Pauli expectations plus bias

reset_architecture_replication.inputs: iid U[0,1], paired within each Hamiltonian and task
reset_architecture_replication.scope: the replication establishes transfer across the two tested input encodings while retaining the N=5 XX+Z processor and Pauli readout; it is not a claim of universal architecture independence

start_definitions: inverse-softplus transform of the seed-specific unequal-rate profile

adaptive_optimizer.start_definition: a_i drawn from Normal(0,0.5) and b_i=0.5 using the seed-specific generator after the Hamiltonian, input, and unequal-rate draws

start_definitions: inverse-softplus transform of a seed-specific log-uniform profile

experiment_2.archive_scope_note: scripts, settings, seeds, and held-out scores are archived; rerunning the sealed scripts reconstructs learned profiles

experiment_3.independent_estimator: q preparations for each of 45 observables
experiment_3.grouped_estimator: 15*q preparations in each global X, Y, and Z product basis
experiment_3.measurement_rng: numpy.random.SeedSequence([20260723, seed, channel_index, model_index, shots_per_observable]) as recorded in the sealed protocol
experiment_3.problem_rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed); couplings are drawn before the STM input
experiment_3.ridge_selection: maximize summed validation STM after fitting on train; refit on train+validation; score the untouched test once

phase_direction_confirmation.purpose: test whether coefficient direction affects readout-accessible STM within otherwise matched rank-one shared relaxation
phase_direction_confirmation.conditions: five prespecified phase-gradient directions and four frozen non-affine zero-overlap fifth-root permutations
phase_direction_confirmation.held_fixed: Hamiltonian, input, target, split, 45 Pauli features, rank one, Kossakowski spectrum and diagonal, coefficient magnitudes, magnitude IPR, and B=80
phase_direction_confirmation.sensitivity_readout: 450 training plus 150 validation rows, validation-selected ridge, refit on 600 rows
phase_direction_confirmation.primary_estimand: equal-phase STM minus orthogonal Fourier-direction STM
phase_direction_confirmation.convergence_gate: all nine directions on the first eight fresh seeds, four initial states, strict washout 800
phase_direction_confirmation.validation: all 72 convergence cells and all 288 task cells authenticate; an independent numerical replay confirms single- and four-right-hand-side propagation within 1e-12 in features
phase_direction_confirmation.scope: the intervention identifies direction as relevant along the tested matched rank-one paths; it does not establish a universal mechanism or globally optimal phase pattern

rank_one_orientation_replication.purpose: replicate the rank-one direction intervention at a second finite size using a real sign-balanced direction orthogonal to the uniform site profile of the fixed Hamiltonian input drive
rank_one_orientation_replication.held_fixed: Hamiltonian, temporal input stream, Pauli readout, data split, ridge protocol, one lowering jump, Kossakowski rank, nonzero spectrum, trace, sitewise diagonal, coefficient magnitudes, five-dimensional Kossakowski-block kernel, and assigned B=192
rank_one_orientation_replication.lag_resolved: mean paired differences and their 95% Student-t intervals are positive at all 20 tested delays; at delay 20 the means are 0.2787384999879061 versus 0.08715190087585652
rank_one_orientation_replication.response_diagnostics: equal phase has lower feature-space effective rank and a larger leading-singular-energy fraction, hence a more concentrated and front-loaded normalized response; these changes are not detectably associated with the seed-level STM gain and are not claimed as mediators
rank_one_orientation_replication.convergence: ground-versus-mixed audits pass for all 24 pairs at 800 inputs; the first six pairs additionally pass four-state audits using ground, mixed, fully excited, and Haar-random initial states
rank_one_orientation_replication.scope: the intervention establishes orientation dependence within the tested rank-one collective-lowering sector; it does not identify a universal optimum, an asymptotic scaling law, or a unique microscopic mediator
